title: Self-Upgrading Embodied Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.31117v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An embodied agent built on a language model goes to work with the weights it was given and keeps them for life. To get better, it needs more training, or reflection, memory, search or prompts that cost every step and are lost when the task changes. Editing weights by reasoning, weight-space programming, could end this, but has stayed with models that only reason or relied on a far larger commercial model. We introduce the self-upgrading embodied agent, to our knowledge the first that learns from its own experience by upgrading its own weights on the job, between its tasks, with no training, no gradient, no reward model, no second model, no test-time scaling and no harness or prompt engineering. By day a 27B agent works in a household environment. At night it reads its record, finds many of its steps wasted on replies that reach the token limit before any action, traces the habit to one direction in its hidden states, and rewrites one ten

translated_title: 自我升级的具身智能体
translated_abstract: 基于语言模型构建的具身智能体在开始工作时带着出厂即有的权重，并终生保持这些权重不变。为了变得更好，它需要更多的训练，或者依赖反思、记忆、搜索或提示工程——这些方法每一步都要付出代价，且在任务改变时就会失效。通过推理来编辑权重（即权重空间编程）本可以终结这一困境，但目前该方法仅限于纯推理模型，或依赖于规模大得多的商业模型。我们提出了自我升级的具身智能体，据我们所知，这是第一个能够通过在任务之间升级自身权重、从自身经验中学习的具身智能体——无需训练、无需梯度、无需奖励模型、无需第二个模型、无需测试时扩展，也无需外部脚手架或提示工程。白天，一个27B的智能体在家庭环境中工作。晚上，它阅读自己的工作记录，发现许多步骤浪费在回复触及token上限却未执行任何动作上，将这一习惯追溯到其隐藏状态中的某一个方向，并重写了其中一部分……
tldr: 提出了首个通过权重空间编程在任务间隙自我编辑权重、从自身经验中学习的具身智能体，无需训练、梯度、奖励模型或额外模型即可实现持续自我改进。
en_tdlr: Introduces the first self-upgrading embodied agent that learns from its own experience by editing its own weights in weight space between tasks—requiring no training, gradients, reward models, or additional models.
